summary.description: One sentence on what the idea is about.

findings.description: The proposed requirement entities: goals, actors, stories, use cases and glossary terms.

severity.description: Always null: a proposal has no severity.

confidence.description: Model confidence 0.0-1.0 that the idea calls for this entity, or null.

evidenceReferences.description: Exact words from the idea that the proposal comes from. Empty when it is inferred.

suggestedIssueText.description: The proposed entity's text: its description, or a glossary term's definition.

suggestedNoteText.description: What in the idea led to the proposal, or an assumption flagged as such. Null for none.

participants.description: The other entities this one refers to, each as TYPE:name, naming another proposal in this response or an entity that already exists in the project. A story or use case lists its primary actor first, then its goals.

warnings.description: Open questions and assumptions about the idea as a whole.
